subject: Renewal + expansion: Clearwater Labs — onboarding 3 new apps & revised term amendment
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Turner <jessica.turner@clearwaterlabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion: Clearwater Labs — onboarding 3 new apps & revised term amendment

Hi Jessica —

Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week. Per our call, Clearwater is planning to expand Redwood usage to three additional internal projects (IngestPipeline, ConsumerInsights, and AuditAssist) as part of the 2027 renewal. To move this quickly we put together a short amendment that:

- Adds three dedicated API key bundles (one per project) with per-key quota caps
- Increases committed token volume by 40% for the 12-month term
- Staggers onboarding to reduce go-live risk (staging -> pilot -> production)

I attached a draft SOW and a simple API key request CSV you can hand to your infra team. Can you confirm the target pilot start date for IngestPipeline and whether Procurement should expect a single PO for the amendment or separate POs per BU?

Attachments: [Clearwater_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)], [API-Key-Request-Template.csv (CSV)]

If it helps, Vanessa and I are available next week to walk the engineering and procurement teams through the rollout plan.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147

From: Jessica Turner <jessica.turner@clearwaterlabs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Murray <alex.murray@clearwaterlabs.com>, Clearwater Labs Procurement <procurement@clearwaterlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: Clearwater Labs — onboarding 3 new apps & revised term amendment

Logan —

Appreciate the doc and the template. High level: we are supportive of the three-app expansion. A few quick asks from our side before procurement can commit: 

1) We need separate API keys per app and a path to rotate keys without downtime (AuditAssist is security-sensitive).
2) Can you send a short flow for staging -> pilot -> prod with estimated token SLOs per phase?
3) Procurement prefers a single PO that references the amendment rather than multiple smaller POs.

Procurement looped in Procurement (procurement@clearwaterlabs.com) and Alex from engineering to validate timelines. We are targeting a pilot kickoff for IngestPipeline the week of May 17 but that depends on key provisioning and a short security review.

Please include any compliance artifacts (SOC2 evidence summary or logging/audit options) in the doc package so our security tooling team can do a quick pass.

Thanks,
Jessica Turner
Head of Product Operations — Clearwater Labs
jessica.turner@clearwaterlabs.com

> Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week...
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Turner <jessica.turner@clearwaterlabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: Clearwater Labs — onboarding 3 new apps & revised term amendment

Jessica —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick responses inline: 

1) Separate API keys: yes, we will issue one key per project. We support key rotation with zero-downtime using overlapping key rollout and per-request key header. I attached the API-Key-Request-Template for Alex to populate with each project owner and IP ranges if you use IP locks.

2) Rollout flow (summary):
  - Staging (2 weeks): smoke tests, integration with logging. Token use estimate: 50k tokens/day per app (ingest)
  - Pilot (4 weeks): limited production traffic from 10% of users. Token estimate: 200k tokens/day
  - Production (ongoing): full traffic. Token estimate: 700k tokens/day across the three apps in steady state

We will supply an SLO template (latency and error budgets) and a runbook for escalation during pilot.

3) PO: single PO referencing amendment is fine — we'll add standard procurement language to the amendment.

Attachments: [API-Key-Request-Template.csv], [Clearwater_Amendment-Draft.docx]

Next steps: Vanessa and I can run a 30-minute kickoff with Alex + Procurement on Wed 4/21 or Thu 4/22. Which works for you? If you confirm, we'll send a calendar invite and pre-read.

Best,
Logan

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Capacity, quotas, and dedicated pool recommendation (Clearwater)

Folks —

Quick internal note to capture constraints for the kickoff:

- With the projected steady-state (~700k tokens/day), we recommend putting Clearwater on a small dedicated pool for predictable latency during peak windows. Dedicated reduces cold-start risk for AuditAssist (security) and ensures KV cache locality for IngestPipeline.
- Cost delta vs. hosted: ~18% premium for guaranteed capacity; we should call this out in the amendment as an optional line item for them to accept.
- Key rotation tooling: Monica, please prepare the rotation steps doc and include the HSM/KMS integration notes for audit requirements.

I'll join the customer kickoff to present the dedicated option.

Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Jessica Turner <jessica.turner@clearwaterlabs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Clearwater Labs Procurement <procurement@clearwaterlabs.com>, Alex Murray <alex.murray@clearwaterlabs.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: Clearwater Labs — onboarding 3 new apps & revised term amendment

Logan/Vanessa —

Thanks for the details and for the clear rollout plan. We had an internal alignment and agree to proceed on the following path: 

- Clearwater will sign the amendment referencing the 12-month term with the 40% committed increase. Procurement will issue a single PO referencing the amendment.
- We want AuditAssist on a dedicated pool (please include the optional line item in the final amendment).
- We confirmed pilot kickoff for IngestPipeline the week of May 17; Alex will send the filled API-Key-Request-Template by Monday 4/26.

Procurement has the draft SOW and will return a signed DocuSign envelope once the final amendment is updated. Sending procurement contact separately.

CC: procurement@clearwaterlabs.com — please expect a DocuSign link from Redwood shortly.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Jessica Turner
